##### **About Company**


Arcitech AI, located in Navi Mumbai's bustling Vashi, is a trailblazer in software and IT, specializing in software development, AI, mobile apps, and integrative solutions. Committed to excellence and innovation, Arcitech AI offers incredible growth opportunities for team members. Enjoy unique perks like weekends off and a provident fund. Our vibrant culture is friendly and cooperative, fostering a dynamic work environment that inspires creativity and forward\-thinking. Join us to shape the future of technology.


Unit No. 15, Ground Floor, E Wing, Phase \- I, Akshar Business Park, Sector \- 25, Vashi\- 400703\.


##### **Job Description**


**Python Developer Intern (Django / Backend)**
==============================================


Back\-End \| Vashi, Navi Mumbai (On\-site) \| 3\-Month Internship


**INTERNSHIP STRUCTURE**
------------------------


Duration: 3 months, on\-site.


Conversion: Performance during the internship is reviewed at the end of the term. Strong performers are


converted to a full\-time role at Arcitech AI; this is not automatic and is assessed against the same bar as our


full\-time hires for this function.


Prior project experience (academic, personal, freelance, hackathon, or open\-source) directly relevant to this


role is required to be considered — we are not hiring purely on academic credentials with no applied work to


show.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


Arcitech AI is looking for a Python Developer Intern to join our backend team, working with Django (and


exposure to FastAPI) alongside our full\-time Python Developers. You will work on real APIs and services


within our product portfolio, under senior guidance. Strong performers over the 3\-month term will be


considered for a full\-time Python Developer role.


You should already have written real backend code — a project with a database, some API endpoints, and


actual logic, not just tutorial exercises. We will build your depth in our stack; we expect the fundamentals


already in place.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Build and maintain backend features using Django (or FastAPI) under the guidance of a senior Python


Developer.


* Build and consume REST APIs, following our existing conventions and code standards.


* Work with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) — writing queries, using the ORM, understanding


basic indexing.


* Write unit tests for the code you write (pytest/unittest) and get comfortable with our testing expectations.


* Get exposure to Docker, Redis/Celery, and our AWS setup as you work alongside the team on real


tickets.


* Participate in code reviews and Git\-based workflows (branching, PRs).


* Own at least one small backend feature or endpoint end\-to\-end during the internship, as a basis for your


conversion evaluation.


**Qualifications**
------------------


* Pursuing or completed a Bachelor\&\#39;s degree in Computer Science or a related field.


* 0–1 years of professional experience — internships, coursework, and self\-driven projects all count.


* Mandatory: at least one backend project (Django, Flask, or FastAPI) with a real database and working


API endpoints — academic, personal, freelance, hackathon, or open\-source. Applications without a


demonstrable project will not be considered.


**Skills**
----------


* Working knowledge of Python (3\.9\+) and at least one web framework (Django preferred; Flask/FastAPI


acceptable).


* Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.


* Familiarity with REST API concepts.


* Some exposure to Git.


* Strong problem\-solving skills and comfort reading other people\&\#39;s code.


* Clear communication — able to explain what you built, and why you made the choices you did.


**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Exposure to Docker.


* Exposure to Celery, Redis, or any message queue.


* A GitHub profile with visible backend code.


* Basic familiarity with AWS (EC2, S3\) or any cloud platform.


Other Details


This is a 3\-month, on\-site internship based at our Vashi, Navi Mumbai office. You will be mentored directly by


our backend engineering team.


Please include a link to your GitHub or a clear description of your backend project(s) with your application —


this is required for shortlisting.


Performance is evaluated against code quality, ownership, and how you respond to review feedback, not just


task completion.


**Compensation**
----------------


Stipend Range: ₹1,20,000 – ₹1,80,000 per annum (approx. ₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month), based on skill


assessment during the interview process.

Mumbai, Maharashtra
**Job Summary**
---------------


We are currently seeking a skilled FIS Front Arena (FIS Cross\-Asset Trading and Risk Platform) developer to join our growing technology function in Mumbai.


Operating in an agile and collaborative environment, the GPS Technology team works closely with product owners and business stakeholders to design, develop, and support advanced trading and risk management solutions. These systems are central to our global trading operations, combining performance, scalability, and regulatory compliance.


In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for the development and ongoing support of our mission\-critical Front Arena platform. As a key member of the technology team, you will enhance its functionality and customise the environment to meet evolving business requirements. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams—including traders, quantitative analysts, risk managers, and middle office colleagues—to drive the design, development, and deployment of new features and system enhancements. With a commitment to the highest standards of quality and reliability, you will help ensure continuous system availability, optimal performance, and seamless integration with critical upstream and downstream systems such as our market data platform, pricing engines, and back\-office applications.


We are seeking a senior Front Arena developer with proven technical expertise in ACM, ADFL, Python, and SQL, along with hands\-on experience in the installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and production support of Front Arena environments. Strong problem\-solving abilities, rigorous attention to quality, and the capacity to work independently with minimal supervision are essential to thrive in this dynamic and high\-performing team.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Core Responsibilities**

* Serve as a key member of the GPS Agile Release Train; actively participate in Program Increment (PI) planning and regular agile ceremonies within a global setup


* Customize and enhance the Front Arena environment to develop new business features, and ensure seamless integration


* Design, build, test, and deploy new functionalities and services to strengthen our trading ecosystem


* Supervise and ensure business\-critical services and features are available and functioning correctly in production, with strong emphasis on high availability and minimal downtime


* Schedule End\-of\-Day (EOD) processes and oversee their timely and accurate completion


* Provide expert\-level support and troubleshooting assistance to Global GPS Application Support teams and the global user base (Level 2 and 3\)


* Participate in on\-call duties for production support, ensuring rapid and effective resolution of issues to minimize impact on business operations

  

**Change Management**

* Conduct code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards, best practices, and security requirements


* Proactively drive continuous platform improvement by identifying optimization opportunities and implementing changes to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk


* Support change management processes and contribute to release rollout planning

  

**Regulatory Responsibilities \& Risk Management**

* Demonstrate appropriate values and behaviors, including but not limited to standards of honesty and integrity, due care and diligence, management of conflicts of interest, competence and continuous development, sound risk management, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Professional and Technical**

* 8\+ years must have hands\-on experience in managing and developing the Front Arena environment (ADFL/AEL/ACM)


* Required knowledge of capital markets and trading, particularly in structured products and equity derivatives.


* In\-depth understanding of the lifecycle management of financial products (e.g. Cash Flows, Corporate Actions, Expiries)


* Experience in software engineering and system administration, with a focus on latest versions of Front Arena Prime


* Demonstrated experience with Front Arena components, data\- and workflows


* Proficiency in scripting languages (Python), solid understanding of databases, SQL queries, database technologies (MS\-SQL), and Microsoft Windows operating system.


* Familiarity with messaging systems (e.g. MQ, Kafka) and task automation is advantageous


* Experience working with agile development methodologies and version control systems (e.g., Bitbucket, Git, etc.)


**Personal and Social**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, or a related field
* Outstanding programming and financial engineering qualification
* Able to work autonomously in a global team setup to take on initiative with a positive attitude.
* Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, with a focus on delivering high\-quality results under tight deadlines.
* Solution oriented personality. Able to quickly troubleshoot problems and provide effective solutions.
* Highly motivated blended with a team player spirit
* Excellent command of verbal and written communication skills

* Timely delivery of AI and web development projects.

* Tool performance, stability, and availability.

* Reliability of APIs and system integrations.
* Bug resolution and technical support response time.
* Internal user adoption and satisfaction.
* Number and impact of innovative AI solutions proposed and implemented.

**Preferred Candidate**
